raw_text: After the update our roadmap page shows overlapping text and half the buttons don't respond. Our planning meeting is in an hour, please escalate.
PRD version history shows the wrong author for edits made by our contractor account.
Exporting feedback only gives raw text, with no sentiment or theme columns, which makes the export useless for our report. Is there a setting?
Our new hire cannot accept the workspace invite, the link says expired though it was sent an hour ago.
Roadmap sometimes loads empty on first visit and fills in after a refresh. Cannot reproduce reliably.
Thanks for the guidance on batching imports. Imports now finish in minutes instead of hours.
Can we choose which sections to include when exporting a PRD to PDF? Sometimes we only need the requirements.
Password reset email isn't arriving. Checked spam, tried with two email addresses.
Hi team, how do I change the default view of the roadmap from timeline to board? I can't find the setting anywhere.
PRD generation keeps timing out when the linked theme has more than 500 feedback items.
Just wanted to say the new priority colour scheme is much clearer, thanks for listening to our feedback.
Loading speed is back to normal after your fix, thank you for the quick response.
Is there a way to integrate with Jira? We want approved user stories to create tickets automatically.
Dropdown menus on the feedback page are cut off at the bottom of the screen so I can't select the last options.
Dark mode toggle doesn't persist, it goes back to light every time I log in.
Can you confirm the session timeout duration for our workspace?
Production workspace is completely unresponsive. Pages time out after 60 seconds and our quarterly planning is blocked.
Appreciate the help with the SAML attribute mapping, everything works as expected.
Data loss: our saved PRD from yesterday is blank when opened. Please restore from backup urgently.
Bug confirmed fixed in the latest build, thanks for the fast fix. Please close this ticket.
Would it be possible to add a second reviewer step in the PRD approval flow?
Console shows a failed network request on the dashboard, but everything still works.
Notification panel opens instantly now, thanks for the performance fix.
Jira sync marks all issues as 'to do' even when they're done in Jira. Our roadmap is now inaccurate.
Security review failed because there's no audit log export. We need this feature to complete our procurement.
The Spanish labels in the export dialog look correct now, thanks for the quick correction.
Still no option to bulk assign owners on the roadmap. This is a very repetitive task for us.
Does the platform support webhooks? We want to trigger our internal workflow when a PRD is approved.
Our team needs Okta group sync for role assignment. Without it we have to manage permissions manually.
Search function freezes the browser when I type quickly. Seen in Chrome and Edge.
Page switches between roadmap and dashboard are noticeably lagging since the last update.
The Jira sync feature saved us hours this sprint. Just wanted to say thank you.
Is it normal for the AI summary to take about 15 seconds on long threads?
Any plans for Microsoft Teams integration? Our company doesn't use Slack.
Wanted to report that the tooltip for RICE score shows 'undefined' in one place.
Can the AI user story generator follow our company's own template? Currently the format is fixed.
Do you support passwordless login for contractors?
Error 500 when exporting PRD to PDF. Reproduced on two different PRDs. Steps and screenshot attached.
Feature request: attach files and screenshots directly to feedback items.
Question about the layout: can I hide the sidebar permanently? It takes up too much room on my laptop.
Is there a known performance issue today? Pages feel slower than usual.
Importing Intercom conversations is manual for us right now, we copy and paste each one. That is a lot of wasted time.
Feature request: Slack notifications when a new theme crosses a threshold of feedback items.
Can someone explain what the coloured dots next to each theme mean? I couldn't find it in the help centre.
We plan to onboard 200 more users next month. Can you confirm the platform can handle that load?
I'd like to add custom fields for customer tier, but the option isn't available on our plan. Can that be changed?
The 'Generate user stories' button is greyed out for all our users after the last release. Blocking sprint planning.
The tip you sent about collapsing the filter panel worked perfectly. Thank you!
Roadmap dates appear one day earlier for us in IST. Is that timezone handling expected?
Request to allow custom statuses on roadmap items, beyond planned, in progress and completed.
Requesting guidance on setting up a saved view of high priority feedback only. The UI doesn't make it obvious.
Thanks for the walkthrough, the new filters make sense now. Closing this ticket.
Roadmap export has been running for 25 minutes. We need the file for a board meeting this afternoon.
The user story generator returns an empty result when the theme name has an ampersand in it.
Thanks, the stale theme tags are gone after your data fix.
Cursor jumps to the beginning of the line while typing in the PRD editor. Happens in Firefox only.
Noticing a brief pause in the PRD editor every few seconds when autosave runs. Is that expected?
Dashboard takes more than 40 seconds to load for everyone in our workspace since yesterday. Tickets from three users already.
Thanks for the quick patch on the CSV encoding problem. Special characters now show up correctly.
The save button on the PRD page is hidden behind the footer on my screen resolution. Attaching a screenshot, please fix.
Single sign on redirect loop on Safari, users can't get past the login screen.
How can I change the email address linked to my login? I changed jobs.
Do you have a CDN? Our users in Australia notice slow loading of assets.
We want to enforce SSO only for our domain. Where can I configure that?
Is there a way to resize the columns in the prioritisation table? Everything is squeezed.
CSV import of 8,000 rows has been stuck at 'processing' for over an hour.
The new Slack integration works great. One extra idea: allow posting to different channels per theme.
Filter by date range ignores the end date. Items after it still appear.
Please consider adding an API endpoint to fetch roadmap items. We want to show them on our internal portal.
We were told during the sales demo that Confluence export was coming soon. It's been months, do you have an ETA?
SSO is working correctly after your configuration steps. Thank you for the quick help.
Remember me finally works after clearing cookies as you suggested. Thanks!
Comment notifications are sent to the wrong user, our PM got comments meant for the design lead.
Slack integration posts duplicate messages, five copies for every new theme. Our channel is flooded.
Seeing a minor visual glitch with the sentiment chart legend overlapping on small screens.
Pop up for the onboarding tour keeps coming back every time I log in even though I dismissed it.
Could you check the server status? Our team in India sees slow response times in the afternoons.
Thanks, the password reset worked now. I can log in again.
Imported CSV shows duplicate rows for each feedback item. Happens every time with our Zendesk export.
How do I enable two factor authentication for my account?
Is Azure AD supported for SSO? Our IT team needs to know before we commit.
Thanks for adding the Markdown export, exactly what we asked for. Please close the ticket.
Not sure if this is a bug: the roadmap shows a completed item as 'in progress' after a refresh.
Tooltip text is cut off on the theme cards and unreadable. Using Chrome on Windows.
Thanks for fixing the sidebar issue so quickly. Everything looks right now.
The feedback list takes a few seconds to apply filters. Can you check if something is off with our account?
How do I rename a theme? I clicked around but nothing seems editable.
Mobile view of the dashboard is broken on iPhone, charts overflow the screen and I can't scroll.
None of our 40 users can log in via SSO since 9 AM. Error: 'SAML assertion invalid'. Please escalate immediately.
What are the recommended limits for the number of feedback items per workspace before things slow down?
Error message on login says 'something went wrong' with no further details. Hard to know what to fix.
AI summary contains information that isn't in our feedback. Looks like a hallucination, ticket reference attached.
2FA codes from Google Authenticator are rejected, time sync on my phone is correct.
Invited users get a 'user already exists' error although they've never signed up.
Locked out after entering the wrong password several times. Please unlock account for my email.
Getting logged out repeatedly every 15 minutes while working. Using Chrome, cookies enabled.
Theme clustering job fails after 10 minutes with a timeout error. We have tried three times with the same dataset.
Login works but dashboard shows a blank white page for admins only. Console reports a TypeError.
Admin account compromised? We see login attempts from unknown locations in the audit log and need help securing the workspace right now.
Confirming the speed improvements from last week's release. Our dashboard loads in under three seconds now.
